title: Batching changes request count, not input payload
method: Synthetic 100,000 records * 1,000 bytes = 100 MB decimal. PUT count = 100,000 / records per object, for batches of 1, 100, and 1,000. Excludes multipart uploads, metadata, compression, and retries; not a price or throughput benchmark.
